evidence_quote: securely store, rotate and isolate credentials
notes: Privilege Cloud + PAM Self-Hosted Digital Vault; SRS replaces legacy CPM for SaaS rotation. Both human and non-human identities covered.

evidence_quote: sessions are fully isolated and credentials never exposed
notes: PSM proxies RDP/SSH/web sessions; credential never touches end-user device. PSM for SSH covers Unix/Linux.

evidence_quote: activities in each privileged session recorded in text and/or video
notes: Full video and keystroke recording stored in Vault; tamper-resistant; searchable. Applies to Privilege Cloud and Self-Hosted.

evidence_quote: temporary elevation of privileges on a by-request, timed basis
notes: JIT via EPM (endpoint), Secure Infrastructure Access ephemeral accounts, and short-lived SSH certs. Zero-standing-privilege model documented across product line.

evidence_quote: CPM Scanner scans Windows and Unix machines for new accounts
notes: Account Discovery covers Windows/Unix/macOS local admin, AWS IAM, AD service accounts. New SaaS Discovery Service added in 2024-25. Onboarding rules auto-remediate.

evidence_quote: apps connect to Secretless Broker without credentials
notes: Conjur/Secrets Manager + Application Access Manager (AAM) broker credentials to apps/pipelines/containers. Secretless Broker eliminates hard-coded secrets. CCP/AIM SDK paths also available.

evidence_quote: multi-factor authentication to authenticate users for privileged access
notes: CyberArk Identity MFA (TOTP, push, biometric, FIDO2) enforced at PSM session launch and portal login. Adaptive MFA rules based on risk signals.

evidence_quote: offline access via CyberArk mobile app can be used
notes: Break-glass documented: dedicated safe, dual-control optional, offline mobile retrieval, root/admin accounts. CRDR adds regional resilience. Not a separate SKU—built into vault design.

evidence_quote: enforces least privilege and adaptive application controls
notes: EPM is a dedicated product line (Windows/macOS/Linux). Removes local admin, JIT elevation, application allowlist/blocklist, credential theft blocking, ransomware protection.

evidence_quote: users and applications only have permissions necessary for their roles
notes: EPM enforces least-privilege at endpoint layer. Secure Cloud Access adds least-privilege scoping for cloud sessions. CIEM/Cloud Entitlements Manager handles cloud entitlement right-sizing. Cross-product coverage; no single unified entitlement analytics console.

evidence_quote: secure third-party access without VPNs, passwords or agents
notes: CyberArk Remote Access (formerly Alero) is a dedicated SaaS product for vendor/third-party access. Biometric MFA, JIT provisioning, no VPN, full session recording via PSM.

evidence_quote: zero standing privileges secures identities at every layer
notes: Cloud Entitlements Manager (CIEM) is a dedicated SaaS product. Secure Cloud Access adds JIT session-level access to AWS/Azure/GCP consoles and CLIs. Named CIEM Leader by KuppingerCole 2023. Separate SKU from core PAM.

evidence_quote: workloads authenticate to Conjur by means of a workload identity
notes: Conjur provides workload identity via Kubernetes service accounts, OIDC, JWT, cert-based auth. Secretless Broker removes credential handling entirely from workload code. Strong k8s/container posture; non-container workload coverage slightly narrower.

evidence_quote: periodic reviews of user access to various resources including Safes
notes: CyberArk Identity Compliance provides certification campaigns for Safes and roles. SCIM integration enables SailPoint/other IGA to manage privileged account lifecycle. Native certification is ADD-ON module (Identity Compliance); not bundled with PAM SKU.

evidence_quote: continuously monitors use of privileged accounts for indications of abuse
notes: PTA (Privileged Threat Analytics) provides behavioral baselines, anomaly scoring, SIEM forwarding, and Vault-native alerting. Available in PAM Self-Hosted; Privilege Cloud equivalent via SIEM integration. PTA is included in Self-Hosted; Privilege Cloud analytics rely more on SIEM.

evidence_quote: detects and blocks attempts to steal credentials from Windows and browsers
notes: EPM blocks hash harvesting (pass-the-hash), Kerberos ticket theft (golden ticket). PTA detects lateral movement and credential misuse from vault perspective. Strong endpoint + PAM-level coverage; cloud credential theft detection relies on CIEM/SIEM integration.

evidence_quote: PAM solution provides layered continuity across availability zones
notes: Privilege Cloud: multi-AZ active/active in AWS. Self-Hosted: DR Vault + PVWA HA documented. CRDR (cross-region) is ADD-ON license. Mobile app offline access for break-glass. Mature HA for SaaS; self-hosted HA complexity is customer-managed.
